Why would a company use RAG for its chat: A company would use RAG for its chatbot so that the bot can pull in up‑to‑date, domain‑specific information—such as internal company data or authoritative sources—rather than relying only on the static knowledge the LLM was trained on. This lets the chatbot provide more accurate, relevant answers and also cite the sources it used, which can help users verify the information.
What are the benefits of RAG besides red: RAG reduces the need to retrain LLMs with new data, saving on computational and financial costs.  Beyond these efficiency gains, it also allows LLMs to include sources in their responses, so users can verify the cited sources.
